question.text: From July 1, 2024, where must FATCA and CRS certifications be uploaded?

answer.text: To the KRA (KYC Registration Agency) systems

explanation.text: The Logic: With effect from July 1, 2024, reporting financial institutions must upload FATCA and CRS certifications obtained from clients to KRA systems, centralising this information alongside KYC records. The Trap: While downstream FATCA reporting flows to CBDT for international exchange, the certification upload itself goes to the KRA, not directly to CBDT or to a SEBI portal. The original stem also referred to FATCA CRA certifications, which is a typo for FATCA and CRS. Note: When onboarding investors after July 1, 2024, check FATCA/CRS certification status at the KRA level; pending certifications can hold up account processing.
